name: Trasee
tagline: Runs your Python code and draws the data structures it builds, such as linked lists and trees, step by step.
problem: Code visualizers treat every variable alike, so linked lists and trees are hard to picture.
solution: Executes Python in the browser and detects structures, rendering node chains and hierarchical trees with an editor and example problems.
demo_moment: Team-described: step through a linked-list solution and watch nodes connect.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Revolutionizing Learning Hack” among 124 submissions.
Recognizes structures the way a learner thinks about them.
A solo, AI-free build won the learning category.

lessons: A precise improvement on a known tool can beat broad AI features.
